materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/NXML, PDF text, OA package supplement PDF, figure captions/images, landed supplementary HTML bins, and linked/merged database rows were checked. No blocking local source gap remains for worker-4/6 obtainable-only publication-grade curation.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled 76 linked database rows against Table 1, Supplementary Table S2, article metadata, sequence evidence, and merged APD6/DBAASP/CAMP rows. Source-supported conflicts remain labelled source_conflict instead of being hidden.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-6 rebuilt final activity/toxicity evidence from the single source Table 1, added all Pinipesin AC ND/NT comparator cells, and captured all locally recoverable Supplementary Table S2 hemolysis values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced placeholder mechanism notes with source-reviewed limited membrane interaction, negative DNA binding, and inferred protein-synthesis interference claims, with direct-assay and limitation fields preserved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: OA package supplement PDF text was opened and used for physicochemical/hemolysis/source-figure context. Landed .bin supplementary files were checked with file and are HTML landing pages, not additional spreadsheets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP normalizes Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Typhimurium, while primary Table 1 uses Salmonella Typhimurinum ATCC 14028. Values are source-located, but the name conflict remains explicit.
DBAASP yeast/fungal rows use MFC, while the primary Table 1 cidal column is labelled MBC. Final activity records preserve the source MBC column and worker-4 keeps MFC rows as source_conflict.
Pinipesin AC rows are retained as ND/NT categorical comparator outcomes from Table 1 rather than converted to numeric zeroes.
Protein-synthesis interference is supported only as a possible mechanism from SDS-PAGE protein-profile similarity to streptomycin, not by a direct translation or ribosome assay.
The landed supplementary .bin files are HTML landing pages. The recoverable supplement evidence used for curation is the OA package PDF text containing Supplementary Tables S1/S2 and Figs. S1-S4.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 by completing source-reviewed database reconciliation and final adjudication from local material.
